source_authority: Original NCERT/official textbook PDFs supplied in the package are authoritative. Derived content must preserve source meaning and must not invent unsupported textbook facts.
hindi_handling: Preserve Hindi terminology, poetic form, dialogue, narrative sequence, interview format, and chapter-specific vocabulary.
question_quality: Questions must refer to identifiable chapter events, images, ideas, lines, characters, poetic devices, or source-supported activities. Avoid generic study-strategy questions.
traceability: Every derived item must carry a source_page and source_ref whenever a page-level anchor is possible.
assessment: Assessment items must be answerable from the chapter source; explanations must identify the relevant evidence or reasoning.
resources: Only source-listed resource URLs are retained; no external URL is fabricated.
